## Review Dimensions
- Challenge, goals, scope, governing principle, direction, feasibility, material impact, vision alignment, downstream authority and requested decision: pass. Terminal escaped narrative and compact stored files are concrete inspection barriers. The direction preserves machine JSON and evidence identity while selecting bounded human presentation changes. Existing formatter and isolated encoding/edit construction provide a credible feasibility basis; proof allocation remains with Delivery.

## Scope Preservation Review
- Scope-preservation result: pass. Readable terminal paragraphs, indented new JSON files and readable targeted edits remain visible. No Markdown report exports, bulk historical reformatting, schema migration or token-overhead guarantee is introduced. Preserving historical bytes is an explicit compatibility boundary, not silent narrowing.

## Recommended Proposal Edits
- Recommended edits: none.

## Recommendation
- Approve the bounded direction. It supports VISION.md commitments to inspectable durable evidence without adopting external platform dependencies. The candidate predates this review; this judgment establishes current direction sufficiency only.
